title: Military helicopters following researchers at the crash site
place_text: Aztec crash site, Hart Canyon, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Uh Bill claimed that a couple times at the crash site as he was leaving, he was followed by helicopters, military helicopters. And that actually happened to us once when we were putting the plaque in.

plain: Researchers at the spot in Hart Canyon, near Aztec, New Mexico, where a UFO is said to have crashed, say they have been followed by military helicopters. Scott Ramsey, a researcher of the case, says an earlier researcher named Bill Steinman claimed this happened to him a couple of times in the 1980s as he drove away, and that it happened to Ramsey's own group once while they were putting up a plaque at the site, as if the military still keeps watch over the place.
